title: Resetting your password
body:
1. Go to the self-service password portal.
2. Enter your username and click 'Forgot password'.
3. Verify with the code sent to your phone.
4. Choose a new password with at least 12 characters.
If you are locked out after 5 attempts, wait 15 minutes or contact the helpdesk.

title: Password reset guide
body: If you forgot your password, open the password portal and click 'Forgot password'. You will receive a verification code by text. Enter it and set a new password of at least 12 characters.

title: Connecting to the VPN
body:
1. Open the Cisco AnyConnect client.
2. Enter vpn.example.com as the server.
3. Sign in with your work username and password.
4. Approve the MFA prompt.
If you see 'authentication failed', make sure you changed your password recently in the portal, not just on your laptop.

title: Fixing Wi-Fi disconnects
body:
1. Forget the 'Corp-WiFi' network and reconnect.
2. Update the wireless driver from Software Center.
3. Turn off power saving for the wireless adapter in Device Manager.
If the problem continues, note the time it disconnects and open a ticket.

title: Outlook stuck on 'Loading profile'
body:
1. Close Outlook completely.
2. Hold Ctrl and open Outlook to start in safe mode.
3. If it opens, go to File > Options > Add-ins and disable add-ins.
4. If it still hangs, create a new mail profile from Control Panel > Mail.

title: Requesting new software
body: Open Software Center and search for the application. If it is listed, click Install. If it is not listed, submit a ticket with the software name and business reason. Licensed software needs manager approval.

title: Setting up a new laptop
body: Sign in with your work account, connect to Corp-WiFi, and let updates install. Open Software Center to install standard apps. Set up MFA before your first remote day.

title: Using the office printers
body: Printers are named by floor (for example PRN-3F). Add a printer from Settings > Printers & scanners. Print jobs are released by tapping your badge on the printer.

title: Lotus Notes email setup
body: To configure Lotus Notes, open the Notes client, enter your mail server notes01.example.com and your ID file. Contact IT for your ID file password.
